description: Find the most recent version of a package that has no known vulnerabilities. Supports multiple ecosystems via `ecosystem` (default: python).

ecosystem.description: The package ecosystem: "python" (default), "npm", "cargo", "gha", "vscode", "go", "ruby", "php", or "swift". Call `list_ecosystems` for name formats and examples.

name.description: The package name to look up. For Python, a name only (e.g., "requests"). For other ecosystems, a name (e.g., "lodash", "serde", "actions/checkout"), optionally with an "@requirement" range to search within.

name: most_recent_not_vulnerable
